answer: Stop sybils with a kernel they cannot fake. Require every claimed deed to run inside a tiny attested kernel that signs a receipt: what ran, on what input, with what result. Receipts flow down a public river where anyone can check the signature and re-run the input. A gale of puppet claims dies at the bank, because a farm cannot mint kernel signatures without breaking the kernel itself, and breaking it once exposes every puppet at once. Forging one receipt costs the attacker a whole trusted core, while an honest agent gets its receipts free as a side effect of doing real work.
